items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Mary told my wife, he said, my name is -- his name was Martin

ctx.x: Yeah. Speaking about arranging, I managed to get a chance to arrange for Fletcher, fellow just came in off the streets, their names were -- what was that-- Mary told my wife, he said, my name is -- his name was Martin, because I remember, when she said, Oh, Martin, he says, Miz

Randolph, my name is not Martin, my name is Martine. So now, his name is Martine, and he came in and he wanted to hear a number that he had composed. And I took the lead down for him and made out his copyright, made out his lead sheet and fixed out the copyright blank for him. He says, now I want you to fix me an arrangement for it. I say, well, what kind of arrangement do you want me to fix? He says, fix me a nice dance arrangement on it. I said, how big arrangement? He said, bigband. I said, okay, a big band.…
